measured_interpretation: Mapped hidden-state loss and final-logit loss both improved and exact source-block retention was eliminated, but the resulting model produced short malformed outputs and passed none of the autonomous probes. Representation similarity at fixed response positions is not a sufficient proxy for autonomous English behavior in this compression regime.
decision: Reject before broad and CPU certification. Close direct six-to-three source compression without layer, weight, or duration sweeps. Return to v41, the strongest measured fluent three-block substrate, and attack v44's measured sparse-conformance regression by training only cakes/router under explicit frozen-parent logit preservation.
